about: Lumbridge's ducks: drakes (duck) and ducks (duck_female) on the River Lum and the pond by Fred's farm, the ducklings that follow the ducks, and the ducks and drakes that walk on land beside the pond south of Mill Lane Mill and on Groats' farm. Tiles and types are RSMod's rev 233 Lumbridge spawns, checked against the 241 map: every swimming one is on water and every walking one on land. Swimmers keep to the water (restrict blocked); their wander range of 35 is RSMod's, and the ducklings stand still unless they follow a duck, as RSMod has them. The walking ducks' range is guessed (5). What they do is in content/Ducks.kt.
